design.linework: Intentional multi-scale paths and details assigned to each main visible surface.
design.palette_roles: Character-related base, theme, and accent colors, chosen per composition.

surface_layout_requirements.dorsal_linework: Primary paths, secondary outlines and fine rhythm across cockpit aft, wing roots and aft spine; review at whole-aircraft display size.
surface_layout_requirements.vertical_tail_character: Character portraits on the two exterior vertical-fin faces only; interior faces use linework, fields and material.
surface_layout_requirements.character_integrity: Keep a large recognizable face and useful neck/upper-body relation on a continuous surface; deliberately crop nonessential artwork before reducing figures to tiny whole-image stickers.
surface_layout_requirements.belly: Linework, palette and material only; no character art on belly or wing undersides.

design.linework_shape_family: Choose a coherent shape family from the character/theme and jet geometry; field boundaries and width/tonal variation can carry hierarchy.
design.material_region_masks: Prefer semantic artwork/paint/metal/mechanical layers or explicit regions; RGB similarity alone is insufficient.
design.artwork_variety: Compare distinct usable poses and expressions; avoid repeating one tiny portrait across all available faces.

lettering.font_choice: Choose with the final composition; previous default serif wordmarks rejected

design.main_character_source: Official character renders/portraits first; official scene illustrations as secondary material
design.tail_composition: Exterior portrait, cloak/hair and fields integrated; no boxed chest portrait

art_acceptance.work_in_progress: Separate temporary workspace; do not add to accepted portfolio.

continuous_refinement.reason: Current Rossi production resumed; no active research goal or automation

agent_workflow.parallel_subagents: Default for substantial independent work; keep useful design, sourcing, material, packaging and review branches active
agent_workflow.user_instruction: 子代理要时刻用起来，我不缺token，我要的是效率和质量

storage_policy.failed_versions: Delete when explicitly requested after retaining actual current dependencies; do not create another failed archive.
storage_policy.intermediates: Keep necessary portable PNG/SVG/source inputs; regenerate large NPY/test output when needed.
